body:
maya: Heads up — found a partner webhook secret embedded in our analytics ingest logs (truncated ciphertext pasted). Looks like a vault-wrapped blob ended up in S3. Need rotation + audit now. :warning:
sam: Thanks. Can you confirm partner and exposure window? Link to runbook: https://runbook.internal/sec/cred-scrub
maya: Partner: acme-inc. Exposure window ~2024-03-18 -> 2024-03-21 (~3 days). Logs were replicated to analytics pipeline but no external sharing detected yet. Recommend immediate rotation, rewrap backups, and tighten Vault RBAC for partner secrets.
alex: I'll take rotation for acme-inc. Which KMS key should we rewrap under? We still on redwood-prod-wrap or do we move to a new key policy?
nina: Recommend new key: redwood-wrap-v2. Also apply a temporary RBAC constraint: create role vault-read-scrub limited to the rotation job and remove broad svcaccount access. Enable audit-forwarding for secrets/partners/* while we sweep.
sam: Rewrap plan (high level): use KMS re-encrypt to produce a new ciphertext and atomically swap in Vault and S3 copies. Sample CLI for a single blob:```
vault read -field=ciphertext secret/partners/acme | gcloud kms reencrypt --ciphertext-file=- --destination-key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/redwood-wrap-v2 | vault write secret/partners/acme ciphertext=@-
```
Note: test in staging canary first. Also ensure vault audit_device is streaming to audit-log-collector.
ops-bot: Incident job created: acme-rotation-202403 by alex (job-id: jr-acme-202403).
jeff: I'll coordinate log purge + analytics owner. Proposed runbook steps: 1) revoke current partner token (immediate), 2) rotate KMS key (create redwood-wrap-v2), 3) rewrap + update S3 blobs, 4) apply RBAC lockdown, 5) enable audit-forwarding + retention 90d. ETA 90m if no blockers. @maya @alex :thumbsup:
maya: Agree. Alex — start a canary in staging and post the result here. Nina — please open the RBAC PR and tag security. Link your PR when ready.
alex: On it. Pushing canary in 5m and will post logs.
ops-bot: Rotation job acme-rotation-202403 started by alex at 3187660100.
ops-bot: Rotation job acme-rotation-202403 completed — SUCCESS. completed_ts=3187660300
